cleavage agent: Proteases were added at a ratio of 1:25 (enzyme weight: sample protein weight) in 125 μL digestion buffer (50 mM TEAB for trypsin; 10 mM phosphate buffer, pH 8.0 for GluC).

fractionation method: Cells were fractionated into cytosol (Cyt), membrane (Mem), and culture supernatant (SN) to achieve a high proteome coverage
